title: Santa Anastasia excavation yields giant skeletons
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Santa Anastasia excavation yields giant skeletons, about 1978-1981 at Church of Santa Anastasia, Sardinia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and the bones of giants would come out of the the site and they would put them in the in the church. They found entire skeletons of giants.

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a dig at the Church of Santa Anastasia on the Italian island of Sardinia, around 1978 to 1981. Passing on what he was told, Alberino says the bones of giants came out of the site and were placed in the church, including entire giant skeletons. If true, it would mean very large humans once lived there.
